result.reason: The duration, professional-services, documentation-conformance, repair, and legal-compliance provisions are largely present, and the longer periods satisfy the fallback durations. Neither level is complete because replacement and refund do not extend to deliverables and all Services, and the malicious-code warranty is materially narrowed by willfulness and design-purpose qualifiers. The drafting also creates overlapping product and added-warranty remedy structures. Because no complete level is achieved, the redline is not minimal, although it does not eliminate unrelated commercial terms or create a direct operative contradiction.
